sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Stupid alarm, why did you die today of all days?!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and panicked about being late, with a burst of irritated self-directed frustration at the alarm for ruining her first day.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Mom's going to say it was fate punishing me for scrolling at midnight...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and self-mocking, half-panicked about being late but trying to lighten the moment with a joking complaint that hides her embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Wait, seriously? They never open this gate.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s abruptly shifting from frantic panic to startled, hopeful curiosity, with a quick spark of relief at the unexpected shortcut and a lively sense that maybe the morning can still be saved.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.text: Yeah, that was the problem, thanks.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s flustered and irritated from being late, but her quick retort shows she’s also trying to stay sharp and not let the situation make her feel helpless.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels wary and puzzled, with a flicker of suspicion beneath her usual blunt, energetic tone as she tries to make sense of the girl’s oddly precise warning.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels startled and suspicious, with a flash of defensive embarrassment at being read so accurately by a stranger.
sprite_sequence.label: unconvinced

sprite_sequence.text: How do you know that before the board goes up?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sharply startled and uneasy, with her usual boldness turning into wary suspicion as she tries to make sense of how this stranger knows something she shouldn’t.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Okay, wow. Creepy. Helpful, maybe, but creepy.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s startled and uneasy, but trying to regain control by joking through her nerves and treating the stranger’s eerie help with wary curiosity.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Yes! I might actually make it!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden burst of relieved, energized optimism as the immediate panic lifts and she sees a real chance of arriving on time.
sprite_sequence.label: natural_smile_cheerful

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is stunned and suddenly shaken, realizing the stranger’s warning was real and feeling a sharp mix of fear, disbelief, and uneasy gratitude.
sprite_sequence.label: astonished

sprite_sequence.text: She said not to use the east stairs.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Aoi is jolted into tense, uneasy alarm as the stranger’s warning suddenly feels ominously real, mixing fear with a sharp sense of being unsettled and impressed.
sprite_sequence.label: uneasy_confused

sprite_sequence.text: Oh, come on. Don't do this to me on day one.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sharp mix of disbelief and rising anxiety, with a frustrated edge because the eerie warning just proved real and she’s suddenly aware she may be caught in something bigger than a bad first day.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated

sprite_sequence.text: Fine. School first. Panic attack later.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is forcing herself into brisk, joking composure to stay functional, while underneath she’s shaken, anxious, and newly convinced something ominous is happening.
sprite_sequence.label: exasperated
